checks.name: Every symbolic owner and pinned session/set relationship is explicit
Accounts access only their own account-owned session
Anonymous ownership requires verified credential context, not a supplied owner label
Admin/editor/worker labels do not grant student-record access
Legacy unowned operator records stay unavailable to students
A child cannot forge an owner while referencing another student session
Claim requires account authentication, source proof, consent and origin checks
Pending or uncertain grading blocks a new claim until reconciliation
Claim preserves record identity while old cookie authority ends
Repeated claim is idempotent for the same account and cannot transfer to another
Ambiguous, revoked or disabled principals fail closed without restoring cookie access
Draft compare-and-swap prevents a second tab from overwriting a newer revision
A newer checked baseline conflicts instead of silently overwriting unfinished work
Foreign draft access hides revision/baseline details
Owner answer restoration preserves whitespace and ordered repeated-name pairs
Private renderer, ownership and correct-answer fields are not projected
Uncertain submission cannot be presented as an accepted mathematical grade
Suppressed private scores cannot leak through feedback or progress correctness
Legacy client grades and unbound snapshots never become pinned renderer progress
Progress excludes foreign owners and cross-version session bindings
Retakes do not duplicate credit for the same pinned exercise version
Synthetic policy evaluation does not mutate fixture data or allocate real IDs

scope: Reference relationship/access/claim/projection checks only. Not deployed authentication, RLS, migrations, transactions or real account transfer.
